CENX.physical_anchor: Primary aluminum smelter — casts aluminum ingot/billet at Grundartangi (Iceland) and Mt. Holly/Hawesville (US) from purchased alumina, not mined bauxite.
CENX.value_chain_position: Downstream smelter/converter — buys third-party alumina and smelts it into primary aluminum metal; does not mine bauxite/alumina ore and is not a copper producer.

CGAU.physical_anchor: Operates open-pit and heap-leach mines producing gold doré (Öksüt, Goldfield) and copper-gold concentrate (Mount Milligan).
CGAU.value_chain_position: Mid-tier producer selling refined gold doré and copper-gold concentrate directly from its own mines — not a converter of purchased ore.

CMC.physical_anchor: Electric-arc-furnace mini-mills recycling purchased scrap steel into rebar, merchant bar and wire products.
CMC.value_chain_position: Downstream converter — melts purchased scrap into finished long-steel products; sells no iron ore/concentrate, the discriminator this chain requires.

CRS.physical_anchor: Melts and forms specialty stainless, titanium and nickel-based alloy bar/billet/wire for aerospace and defense from purchased metal/scrap feedstock.
CRS.value_chain_position: Downstream specialty-alloy converter — buys metal inputs and adds metallurgical value; does not mine or sell ore/concentrate.

CSTM.physical_anchor: Rolls and extrudes aluminum sheet, plate and profiles for aerospace, automotive and packaging from purchased primary and recycled aluminum.
CSTM.value_chain_position: Downstream fabricator — converts purchased aluminum metal into rolled/extruded products; does not mine bauxite or produce primary metal from ore.

ECL.physical_anchor: Manufactures and dispenses water-treatment and industrial-hygiene chemicals and dosing equipment on customer sites.
ECL.value_chain_position: Specialty chemicals/water-treatment services provider — no rare-earth, antimony, gallium or tungsten exposure; caught only by the generic 'Chemicals - Specialty' FMP industry string.

EGO.physical_anchor: Operates open-pit and underground mines producing gold doré (Kışladağ, Lamaque, Efemçukuru).
EGO.value_chain_position: Mid-tier multi-country gold producer selling refined doré from company-operated mines.

EQX.physical_anchor: Operates open-pit mines across the Americas producing gold doré/bullion (Los Filos, Castle Mountain, Greenstone).
EQX.value_chain_position: Multi-asset Americas gold producer selling refined gold from company-operated mines.

ERO.physical_anchor: Operates underground/open-pit mines in Brazil producing copper concentrate with gold byproduct (Caraíba, Tucumã, Xavantina).
ERO.value_chain_position: Focused Brazilian copper producer selling copper concentrate with a gold-byproduct credit; not a converter or processor.

EXK.physical_anchor: Operates underground mines in Mexico producing silver-gold doré/concentrate (Guanaceví, Bolañitos, Terronera).
EXK.value_chain_position: Silver-primary Mexican producer selling doré and concentrate with dominant_metal=silver; gold is the byproduct credit.

FCX.physical_anchor: Operates large open-pit copper mines (Grasberg, Morenci, Cerro Verde) and an integrated smelter producing copper concentrate and cathode with gold/molybdenum byproducts.
FCX.value_chain_position: Major vertically-integrated copper producer (mine through smelter) — sells copper concentrate, cathode, and byproduct gold/moly; not a diversified multi-commodity major.

FNV.physical_anchor: Holds royalty and streaming contracts entitling it to a percentage of gold, PGM and copper output/revenue from mines it does not operate (e.g., Cobre Panama, Candelaria, Antamina).
FNV.value_chain_position: Royalty/streaming layer — no operating or capex exposure, collects contractual metal-linked payment streams across a diversified portfolio; some non-metal energy royalties dilute the pure-gold mix.

FSM.physical_anchor: Operates underground and open-pit mines across the Americas and West Africa producing gold and silver doré/concentrate (Séguéla, Lindero, San Jose).
FSM.value_chain_position: Multi-country gold/silver producer selling refined doré/concentrate from company-operated mines.

GFI.physical_anchor: Operates deep-level and open-pit mines in South Africa, Australia, Ghana and Peru producing gold doré/bullion.
GFI.value_chain_position: Senior multi-country gold producer selling refined gold from company-operated mines.

GGB.physical_anchor: Electric-arc and blast-furnace mini-mills producing long steel (rebar, wire rod) primarily from purchased scrap.
GGB.value_chain_position: Downstream steel converter — sells finished long-steel products, not iron ore/concentrate; any captive ore feeds internal mills only and is never sold externally, the exact converter pattern the chain notes flag for exclusion.

HBM.physical_anchor: Operates open-pit/underground mines (Constancia Peru, Manitoba, Copper World Arizona) producing copper concentrate with zinc, gold and silver byproducts.
HBM.value_chain_position: Polymetallic base-metal producer — sells copper concentrate as the dominant product with meaningful zinc/gold/silver byproduct credits.

HL.physical_anchor: Operates underground mines (Greens Creek, Lucky Friday, Casa Berardi) producing silver-lead-zinc concentrate and gold doré.
HL.value_chain_position: US silver-primary producer selling concentrate/doré from company-operated mines; dominant_metal=silver with a gold byproduct at Casa Berardi.

HMY.physical_anchor: Operates deep-level underground and surface mines in South Africa plus Hidden Valley (PNG) producing gold doré/bullion.
HMY.value_chain_position: South African gold major selling refined gold from company-operated mines; Eva Copper remains a pre-production development asset, not yet revenue.

IAG.physical_anchor: Operates open-pit and underground mines (Essakane Burkina Faso, Côté Gold and Westwood Canada) producing gold doré.
IAG.value_chain_position: Multi-country gold producer selling refined doré from company-operated mines.

IFF.physical_anchor: Synthesizes and formulates flavor, fragrance and specialty food/nutrition ingredients.
IFF.value_chain_position: Flavors & fragrances / specialty-ingredients manufacturer — no linkage to rare earths, antimony, gallium or tungsten; caught only by the generic 'Chemicals - Specialty' FMP industry string.
